zoe.design: Quick note from user testing: multiple tool calls in one run are hard to scan. People couldn't tell which call had a schema problem at a glance.

micah.devex: Agreed. Idea: tiny inline annotation next to each call header that shows schema name + 1-word status (e.g., Mismatch). Click opens a compact popover with a 1-line expected vs actual preview.

alan.product: Product asks the badges must not push main content down. Prefer anchored popover or overlay. Also add a run-list filter: "Only runs with schema issues".

tara.a11y: A11y checklist: badge must be keyboard-focusable, have an aria-label like "Schema validation: CartV3, mismatch" and expose aria-expanded/aria-controls. Popover should be a dialog with focus management. Announce new validation results with aria-live="polite" on run completion. Avoid color-only signals.

vik.runtime: Backend can emit a small `validation_summary` string and `schema_fingerprint` in the invocation payload so the client can render badge text and fetch full diffs on demand. We'll keep detailed diff compute async.

micah.devex: Interaction details: badge = [SchemaName] [icon] [short text<=14 chars]. Keyboard: Enter/Space opens popover, Esc closes. Popover monospace one-line diff + CTA "Open full inspector". If inspector data isn't ready show loader.

zoe.design: Copy ideas: badge states = OK / Mismatch / Partial match. Tooltip: "Schema: CartV3  Mismatch. Press Enter to inspect." Avoid the term "raw"; use "Open JSON view".

tara.a11y: Also include a visible keyboard hint in the popover footer and reference it with aria-describedby. Ensure focus is restored after close.

ci-bot: CI: visual diff job queued for playground run-detail badge changes.

micah.devex: Next steps: vik adds fields to API, zoe to mock badge + popover, tara to review a11y copy, alan to confirm priority. Drop Figma when ready. :sparkles:
